title: GET <product api>/v1/summary[?organization=<id>] (every product; docs/HOME-PLAN.md)
description: A product's one-line live status for one organization (or, without `organization`, across every organization the person reaches in it: the dashboard's app tile), for the home dashboard at account.photonind.com. Authenticated with the person's own token (the account app's; its aud includes the product's project): the product authorizes as for any request and accepts a token issued to another app on this route only. Cheap and cached (30 s per organization, Cache-Control: private, max-age=30, under 300 ms); CORS for https://account.photonind.com. The dashboard waits at most 4 s.

organization_id.description: The organization asked about; null for the answer across all of the person's organizations (then `sites` is empty).

summary.description: One short line in the product's words, e.g. "12 of 12 cameras online · recording".

sites.description: The sites of this organization the product has something to say about; a site left out shows the organization's line.

state.description: ok: all well. attention: something needs a look. down: not working. unknown: the product cannot tell.
